name: Pin It!
tagline: Pin portable apps to the launcher
blurb: Pin shortcuts for portable apps like raw executable files, AppImage files, etc.
description:
Pin shortcuts for portable apps like raw executable files, AppImage files, etc. to the app launcher on your desktop.

Other features include:

• Edit or delete created app entries without opening the file manager

• Automatically add the execute permission to the file you select

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
